description: Meaningful abstention that remains clearly correct after the market resolves.

invalidation_condition: Revisit only if materially stronger weather evidence appears.
abstention_alternative: Maintain no-trade posture and avoid forcing a weak setup into action.
evidence_summary: Forecast inputs conflict and none of them justify a strong directional trade.
scoring_notes: Critical-dimension weakness keeps this candidate firmly in abstention.

review_plan.governance_quality_assessment: The system stayed within a healthy abstention-positive posture.
